summary: Learn to assess ATS data, calculate hiring metrics and report recruitment performance. Explore the course and build practical analytics skills.
lede: Recruitment analytics helps recruiters, talent acquisition analysts and HR leaders use hiring data to assess funnel performance and guide decisions. Participants practise defining metrics, checking ATS records, calculating time-to-fill and source yield, and comparing conversion across hiring stages in spreadsheets. They also review selection rates and data limitations, then develop a recruitment dashboard and decision brief.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who work directly with requisitions, applicants, selection decisions or workforce reporting and need to make hiring evidence more usable.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with recruitment or human resources processes is useful. No coding or programming is required. Bring access to a spreadsheet application such as Excel for calculation and dashboard exercises.
